decision.action: implement RED-first exact IQ3 sign-bit K1024 wave4 sibling
decision.reason: After dimension/workgroup/launch contractions are closed, IQ3 remains a flat 1.448-1.461 ms/token family. A load-free bit-identical sign construction removes 32 compare/select pairs, contracts static instructions and SGPRs, preserves the same allocated VGPR class and all ownership/arithmetic boundaries, and has a bounded first/last actual-weight gate.

actual_weight_precondition.requirement: At both first/last IQ3 layers, candidate producer and inclusive producer+unchanged weighted reducer event/wall medians all improve; BF16 route rows and reduced outputs remain byte-exact. Remove on any failure.

after_actual_weight_pass_only: Add an explicit/default-off gfx1100 schedule with retained wave4 fallback; no capability promotion yet.
Shared-weight 16-transition full logits/IDs, all 48 hidden and 47 routed boundaries, active K/V and every KVLiveSpans field, reset/re-prefill, ownership, and lifecycle identity.

Cached full-model trace proves 45 candidate calls/token, zero retained sign-select producer calls, unchanged 47 weighted reducers and 723 model kernels/token, admitted resources, and no compiler under profiling.

Two process orders at short/512/1K/near-4K: producer and inclusive IQ3 family improve everywhere; kernel sum/span regressions stay below 0.5%; equal-process child throughput stays above -0.5%; IDs/resources/lifecycle pass.
Both complete 18-prompt category process orders: pooled h16/h32 and every train/heldout category decode improve; E2E/prefill/TTFT/state/lifecycle guards pass before gfx1100 default promotion.
codegen: Repository-built candidate is local32/wave32 with production grid 98304 x 10, allocated VGPR <= 88, logical VGPR <= 86, logical SGPR <= 18, LDS0, private0, zero spills, and scratch0.
Static wave4 body is <=499 instructions and <=2736 bytes under the pinned Clang 22 decode profile.
All 32 sign compares and 32 sign cndmasks are absent; the four unrelated cndmasks may remain; no sign table/sidecar/global load is added.
A cached rocprofv3 trace names the sibling candidate with plausible duration and no compiler under profiling.
primitive_correctness: Exhaust all 128 seven-bit sign selectors including computed parity and prove conditional negation and FP32 sign-bit insertion are bit-identical for every positive IQ3 codebook magnitude.

K1024/top-10 candidate BF16 route rows are byte-identical to both retained wave4 and local128 across all 256 codebook entries, repeated/distinct/invalid experts, odd output tails, selector boundaries, and finite BF16 signed-zero/subnormal/extreme activations.
CPU-reference gate remains KL <= 0.05 and top-1 >= 90%; exact sibling comparison requires KL 0 and top-1 100%.
Registry key is gfx1100-only and explicitly absent from gfx1151 aliases; retained wave4 remains the fallback.
frozen_gates.red: Before production implementation, add a failing test for the absent sign-bit K1024 wave4 wrapper/key plus source/oracle contracts. No runtime schedule or capability is added in this first unit.

cache_only_resource_trace.performance_interpretation: None; this single launch proves symbol/resources only.

candidate_vs_current.caveat: Delay instructions increase 37 -> 45 and logical VGPR rises 83 -> 86; only repository-built actual-weight timing may decide performance.

out_of_tree_codegen_probe.purpose: Selection ceiling only. The temporary source substituted the helper globally so the retained wave4 symbol could be isolated; repository implementation must use the sibling-only plan above.

short_amdahl.interpretation: The candidate is a bounded instruction contraction, not a projection that IQ3 will close the Vulkan gap.

selection.arithmetic_contract: Decode the same positive IQ3 codebook byte to the same exactly representable FP32 magnitude, insert selector bit j directly into IEEE-754 bit 31, then execute the same multiplication, scalar FMA sequence, four K256 accumulators, five-stage wave shuffle trees, 0..3 partition add, and BF16 route store. For finite positive integer magnitudes, setting bit 31 is bit-identical to unary negation and changes no association.
selection.candidate: exact load-free IQ3_XXS sign-bit insertion in the retained K1024 wave4 producer
difference_from_closed_mechanisms: No output/head/dimension/workgroup packing and no reduction-tree or arithmetic reassociation.
No heterogeneous IQ2/shared-Q5 owner, projection union, launch removal, graph replay, host packet, or AQL change.
No sign lookup table or sidecar: unlike the rejected IQ2 sign-only LUT, this adds zero memory loads.
No Q8_1 activation quantization or dot4 path; BF16 activations and raw IQ3 bytes are unchanged.
implementation_plan: Add a sibling iq3_xxs_group_dot_signbit helper; do not alter the retained shared helper.
Add a separately registered gguf_iq3_xxs_selected_gemv_k1024_wave4_signbit producer/wrapper/key with the same arguments, grid, and local32 launch.
Keep the current selected_gemv_decode_k1024_wave4_bf16_bf16_out key as the exact fallback and add no runtime selector until primitive/codegen/actual-weight gates pass.
If admitted to runtime, expose a backend capability/schedule value rather than a quant/backend branch in engine or model code, and explicitly exclude the gfx1151 alias.
selection.scope: Only c=1 K1024 wave4 selected-down production. The retained wave4 producer, local128 selected primitive, weighted reducer, all prefill/rows>1 IQ3 paths, raw weights, route buffers, launch geometry, and unsupported backends remain exact fallbacks.

source_audit.lineage_note: Only already-catalogued unrelated Qwen/PARO/smoke parent drift is reported; this is an in-tree arithmetic/codegen specialization, not a port.

temporary_exactness_probe.interpretation: Selection evidence only; the committed RED/GREEN primitive corpus remains mandatory.
